moments.title: Champions League Group Stage Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League group stage continues its first matchday with several key fixtures today and tomorrow, featuring top UK clubs.

angles.name: Matchday Buzz
angles.copy: Champions League Matchday 1 is in full swing! Which UK side are you backing to make an early statement today? Let's talk tactics.

angles.name: UK Clubs in Action
angles.copy: Arsenal face Napoli and Liverpool host Atlético Madrid today as Champions League action continues. Big night for English clubs!

moments.title: Roger Waters' 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal lyricist Roger Waters celebrated his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Still making waves at 83! Roger Waters, the visionary behind so much of Pink Floyd's iconic sound, recently celebrated his birthday.

angles.name: Musical Genius
angles.copy: From 'The Dark Side of the Moon' to 'The Wall', Roger Waters' influence is undeniable. We're still celebrating his 83rd birthday this week.

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Moby
moments.blurb: American DJ, singer, and songwriter Moby, known for hits like 'Porcelain' and 'Why Does My Heart Feel So Bad?', turns 61 on September 11th.

angles.name: Dance Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Electronic music pioneer Moby turns 61 this Friday. What's your all-time favourite Moby track?

angles.name: 90s Flashback
angles.copy: From the underground to global superstar, Moby redefined a generation's sound. Happy 61st for Friday!

moments.title: Niall Horan Turns 33
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter and former One Direction member Niall Horan celebrates his 33rd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Sending early birthday wishes to Niall Horan, who turns 33 this Sunday! What's your favourite solo hit from the Irish star?

angles.name: From 1D to Solo Success
angles.copy: Niall Horan, the voice behind so many anthems, celebrates his 33rd this weekend. What a journey it's been!

moments.title: Remembering Amy Winehouse
moments.blurb: Iconic British soul singer Amy Winehouse would have been 43 on September 14th.

angles.name: Soulful Legacy
angles.copy: On Monday, we remember the incredible Amy Winehouse, who would have been 43. Her unique voice and timeless songs continue to captivate.

angles.name: Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Thinking of Amy Winehouse, whose powerful music still resonates deeply, on what would have been her 43rd birthday this coming Monday.

moments.title: Worcester Music Festival
moments.blurb: The UK's largest donation-entry festival, Worcester Music Festival, takes place from September 11th to 13th, featuring over 350 performances across 25 venues.

angles.name: Festival Weekend
angles.copy: Worcester Music Festival kicks off this Friday! Over 350 acts, 25 venues, and it's all for charity. Who are you seeing?

angles.name: Discover New Music
angles.copy: Looking for new sounds? Worcester Music Festival is this weekend, packed with emerging artists and local talent. Go discover your next favourite band!

moments.title: Reminisce Festival Returns
moments.blurb: Reminisce Festival, a huge celebration of 90s and 00s dance music nostalgia, hits Sherdley Park, St Helens on Saturday, September 12th, featuring acts like Vengaboys and East 17.

angles.name: 90s/00s Throwback
angles.copy: Dust off your glow sticks! Reminisce Festival is this Saturday in St Helens, bringing back all the 90s and 00s dance anthems you love. Who's in?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Vengaboys, East 17, Liberty X – the lineup for Reminisce Festival this weekend is pure nostalgia gold. Get ready to party!

moments.title: The Gentlemen Season 2 Now Streaming
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated second season of Guy Ritchie's crime comedy-drama 'The Gentlemen' premiered on Netflix on September 3rd.

angles.name: Crime & Comedy
angles.copy: If you loved the first season, 'The Gentlemen' is back! Season 2 is now streaming on Netflix – have you dived in yet?

angles.name: Weekend Binge
angles.copy: Your weekend plans sorted: 'The Gentlemen' Season 2 is here. Guy Ritchie's signature style is back on the small screen.

moments.title: Slow Horses Season 6 Premieres
moments.blurb: The sixth season of the acclaimed spy thriller 'Slow Horses', starring Gary Oldman, is set to premiere on Apple TV+ on September 16th.

angles.name: Spy Thriller Return
angles.copy: Gary Oldman and the 'Slow Horses' are back! Season 6 drops next Wednesday on Apple TV+. Get ready for more espionage and dark humour.

angles.name: Wednesday Watch
angles.copy: Mark your calendars for September 16th! The dysfunctional MI5 agents return for another thrilling series of 'Slow Horses'.

moments.title: MobLand Season 2 Arrives
moments.blurb: The second season of the crime drama 'MobLand', featuring Tom Hardy and Pierce Brosnan, will be available on Paramount+ from September 18th.

angles.name: Crime Drama Fix
angles.copy: Tom Hardy and Pierce Brosnan in a crime drama? Yes please! 'MobLand' Season 2 hits Paramount+ next Friday. Who's watching?

angles.name: New Paramount+ Series
angles.copy: The Harrigans are back! Get ready for more gripping drama as 'MobLand' Season 2 premieres on Paramount+ next week.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The 24th series of 'Strictly Come Dancing' kicks off with its highly anticipated launch show on BBC One, Saturday, September 19th at 7:25pm, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Glitterball Season Begins
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is next Saturday. Get ready to meet the new couples and see the fresh presenting line-up!

angles.name: New Hosts, New Moves
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take the reins! Don't miss the Strictly Come Dancing launch next Saturday on BBC One.

moments.title: The Split Up Premieres
moments.blurb: The spin-off series 'The Split Up', set in Manchester's high-net-worth divorce circuit, begins on BBC One on Sunday, September 20th.

angles.name: New BBC Drama
angles.copy: Fans of 'The Split', get ready! Spin-off series 'The Split Up' arrives next Sunday, set in the cutthroat world of Manchester divorce law.

angles.name: Manchester Spotlight
angles.copy: Our city takes centre stage! 'The Split Up', the new drama set in Manchester, premieres next Sunday on BBC One. Will you be tuning in?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Series 17 of 'The Great British Bake Off' begins on Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 22nd at 8pm, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Grab your aprons, Bake Off is back! Series 17 starts Tuesday, September 22nd. And Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the tent!

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent? Yes please! Get ready for a fresh batch of bakers and iconic judging from September 22nd on Channel 4.
